column1: # Every chord `input::keyboard_bytes` writes as a win32-input-mode record pair on Windows
# with a US layout, win32-input-mode on and no keyboard protocol asked (T-KEYBOARD-RECORDS).
# (scripts/dev/generate-key-encoding-table.ps1 copies it into place); read by
# crates/bt-pty/tests/keyboard_protocol_through_conpty.rs, which sends each row through a
# real ConPTY. Columns: key, location, modifiers, the bytes (`\e` is ESC).
